title: Mace endorses old foe Alan Wilson for South Carolina governor: ‘Buried the hatchet’
description: After placing fifth in her bid to be South Carolina‘s next governor, Rep. Nancy Mace (R-SC) conceded and endorsed state Attorney General Alan Wilson, her political foe, for the seat.
